title: new_area_seed_tiles parsed via jint: decimals silently truncate and out-of-i32-range integers wrap, no fail-fast
detail: The new key inherits jint's implicit coercion: "new_area_seed_tiles": 10.5 truncates silently to 10; an integer > i32::MAX wraps. Sibling tunables (cap_fraction_permille, placement.*, terminal keys) use jint_strict to reject exactly this, per ODN-10.
recommended_fix: Parse the new key with jint_strict (rejecting json.Float and out-of-i32-range values like cap_fraction_permille does), and add a decimal-valued loader test row naming growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles.

title: map-diameter guard is loose: sub-diameter seed floors can still permanently stall growth (loads clean, every window exhausts)
detail: Only floor ≥ 50 rejects on the 40×30 map; e.g. 45 loads clean, but every seed candidate must ALSO sit within era span 18 of a junction — with estates spread per cap 5, no candidate clears 45, so all windows exhaust deterministically.
recommended_fix: Tighten the bound to a span-aware maximum (e.g. new_area_seed_tiles < min(map_w, map_h), or ≤ span-based reachability), or document that accepted sub-diameter floors can deterministically stall growth.
